item.title: PyPad 1.8.3 Released
item.description: - PyPad 1.8.3 introduces a new built-in offline tools framework under Tools. - New built-in utilities include Random Number Generator, Password Generator, Percentage / Finance Calculator, Color Picker, and World Clock. - Tool dialogs now support shared help, copy, insert, save, and persisted local tool state. - Command palette discovery and release summaries were updated to reflect the new built-in utilities surface. - Detailed changelog: CHANGELOG.md
